items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: great drummer named Troy Davis, who played a lot with who’s the Jamaican piano player, Monty Alexander

ctx.x: I only did that one time. I had a trio gig in New Orleans, George Porter was the bass player, great drummer named Troy Davis, who played a lot with who’s the Jamaican piano player, Monty Alexander, a really good player, played with Terence Blanchard one © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-

time or two, a really great New Orleans drummer. He was going out for a month with Monty. And I said well just send me somebody good. And he sent one of his students, a brilliant drummer named Simon Lot. So he called me a month later and he goes, “Hey bro I’m back in town, what’s up?” And I go, “Bro, I don’t really know how to tell you this but the guy you sent played you off the gig.” He was that good. This cat had perfect balance. He sounded — he made everything we played sound like a Blue Note record. He was…
